sources.label: Foreplay Spyder product page
sources.claim: Foreplay's Spyder product watches a competitor's new Meta ads and landing pages, keeps a desktop and mobile landing-page archive, sends Slack and email summaries, and publishes an MCP connector on all plans.

sources.label: Foreplay pricing page
sources.claim: Foreplay's public list prices run from $59 a month (Basic) to $459 (Agency), plus per-user and per-brand add-ons; Spyder is part of that stack.
